label: prf:mass-categorical-descent
title: Proof of mass categorical descent
html:
Proof. Proof of mass categorical descent

Proof sketch. The Wedderburn-Artin decomposition H_n(R, q) \cong \bigoplus_{\lambda \vdash n} M_{d_\lambda}(R) identifies Z(H_n(q)) with the diagonal scalars in each block. The mass endomorphism \mathfrak{m} = \sum_i \ln |M_i| decomposes under restriction to each block. The descended component collects terms that factor through the block's Casimir eigenvalue; the transient component collects terms that depend on the specific embedding of generators (i.e., the choice of crossing sites), which is the data localised at exceptional divisors. \square
